claims.text: the hit set holds every reference to gate_native_contract, manifest_skills over the name forms this pass searched

Check C builds the disk skill set from every skills/**/SKILL.md as './'+parent dir, parses the skills array of .claude-plugin/plugin.json and of .codex-plugin/plugin.json independently (trailing '/' stripped), and reports per manifest a skill on disk missing from it or a declared skill absent from disk; any finding exits 2 and the gate returns 2.

The gate runs at Stop via run_gate native-contract when the plugin scope, .agents/* or .codex/* changed in the worktree or on the branch, and at pre-commit with the pass cache disabled; run_gate turns the wire name into the file native-contract-gate.sh and the function gate_native_contract.
A new skills/<group>/<name>/SKILL.md must be listed as ./skills/<group>/<name> in both .claude-plugin/plugin.json skills and .codex-plugin/plugin.json skills, or check C blocks.

The same new skill must also satisfy: native check A (no provider vocabulary in its *.md unless an allow row explains it) and check B (column-zero frontmatter keys within the allowed set); registry check A (listed in .claude-plugin/plugin.json skills), check B (named in both CLAUDE.md and README.md as /afk:<name>, `<name>`, or skills/<group>/<name>), check D (SKILL.md contains LANGUAGE.md), and check F (frontmatter parses, name equals the directory name, description present). Registry checks C (hook env vars) and E (adapters) do not bite a skill-only addition.

The skill-registry gate runs only at Stop (hooks/stop-gates.sh:125); the commit path dispatches native-contract but not skill-registry, so a --no-hooks session is gated at commit only on manifest parity, frontmatter keys and vocabulary.
Registry check B reads CLAUDE.md and README.md only; AGENTS.md is not checked for the catalog mention.

Scope mismatch: native check C and check B glob skills/**/SKILL.md (any depth) while the registry gate and check F glob exactly skills/afk/*/ + skills/utils/*/ and skills/*/*/; a SKILL.md nested deeper or under a third group is demanded in both manifests by native-contract but ignored by the registry catalog, LANGUAGE.md pointer, and name checks. The shipped tree has 45 skill dirs, all two levels deep, identical in both manifests.
citations: python set-diff of both manifests' skills arrays: 45 45 set(), exit 0

Of the six skill-registry checks, four key on a new skill directory: A (listed in .claude-plugin/plugin.json only), B (a /afk:<name>, `<name>` or skills/ path mention in CLAUDE.md and README.md), D (LANGUAGE.md pointer), F (frontmatter parses and names its directory); C reads hooks/*.sh and E reads adapters/, so a skill directory alone cannot trip them.

claims.text: check C builds the disk skill set from the glob skills/**/SKILL.md, so a skill directory counts only once it holds a SKILL.md, at any depth under skills/

manifest_skills reads only the top-level skills array of each manifest, strips a trailing slash, and compares by exact string to './' plus the posix directory path; both manifests are checked independently
a new skill's markdown is scanned by check A for harness vocabulary through rglob('*.md'), with no name of the skill involved
adapter dispatch, the tracker loader, the config codec and the tracker MCP server read no skill directory and no plugin manifest, so a new skill directory leaves them unchanged

Adding skills/<group>/<name>/SKILL.md requires an entry ./skills/<group>/<name> in BOTH .claude-plugin/plugin.json and .codex-plugin/plugin.json skills arrays (native check C); the registry gate's check A reads only the Claude manifest.

Registry checks A, B and D glob only skills/afk/* and skills/utils/*; native check C globs skills/**/SKILL.md at any depth and check F globs skills/*/*/SKILL.md, so a skill under a new group directory is checked by C and F but escapes A, B and D.

A new skill also needs a CLAUDE.md and README.md mention (/afk:<name>, `<name>` or its skills path), the LANGUAGE.md pointer line, and frontmatter that loads as YAML with name equal to the directory, a description, and only allowed top-level keys.
Check C strips a trailing slash from manifest entries while registry check A compares exact strings, so an entry written with a trailing slash passes the native gate and fails the registry gate.
At commit only the native contract gate runs; the registry, wiring and genericity gates run on Stop, so registry drift from a new skill surfaces at Stop, not at commit.
Sibling files of a new skill directory are gated by the wiring gate (SKILL.md is exempt by name) and its prose by the genericity gate and native check A.
Only check F is pinned by a test (scripts/tests/test_skill_frontmatter.py:87-92 live pin); native check C and registry checks A, B, D have no test in scripts/tests or hooks/tests.
